Three enrichment workers (enri-a-05, enri-a-11, enri-a-23) promoted v1→v2 this period retained stale v1 confirmations; the system permitted promotion without invalidating or requiring renewal. R-CONFIRM-VERSION establishes the principle that confirmations are version-bound and do not inherit, but specifies no enforcement action when a promoted worker lacks a fresh confirmation.
rule_draft_offered: R-PROMOTION-STALE-CONFIRM (confirmations): Upon promotion of a worker to a new version, the system shall automatically mark all prior-version confirmations as stale. A worker with no valid confirmation for its current promoted version shall be blocked from running (or flagged for operator attention) until a fresh confirmation is logged for that version. This operationalizes R-CONFIRM-VERSION: the truth must be established again, and the system shall not silently permit execution on inherited authority.
